title: Walk to Broadway from your Private Residence
description:
Challenge friends to a game of billiards within the exposed-brick walls of a former industrial building. This fascinating, art-filled loft is made for fun and entertaining with its ample seating, double Viking fridge, and acres of floor space. Amazing spot only a few steps away from all the action of Printers Alley, Broadway and either one of the 3 stadiums.

Original beechwood hardwood floors, exposed bricks, beautiful french doors and juliette balconies. this condo host a gourmet kitchen perfect for entertaining!
No parking is provided. This is downtown, you should be able to walk everywhere! but there is plenty of public parking around us

the entire condo is yours!

We live onsite so if you have any questions let us know, we ll do our best to help you out!

This downtown loft is walking distance to all three stadiums, honky tonk central on Lower Broadway Is one block away, the Art District, Printers alley is at the end of our alley and all the great restaurants in the city are a few steps away
